priorityList: Pre-cast Arcane Intellect, Mirror Image, and Frostfire Bolt before combat starts.
Activate Combustion (along with Trinkets and Potions) while finishing a Frostfire Bolt, Pyroblast, or Meteor cast to ensure they crit.
During Combustion, cast Meteor as early as possible (ideally within the first 6 seconds).
During Combustion, spend Hot Streak procs on Flamestrike if there are 4 or more targets, otherwise use Pyroblast.
During Combustion, spend Pyroclasm procs on Flamestrike (4+ targets) or Pyroblast if the cast will finish before Combustion ends.
During Combustion, use Scorch if Heat Shimmer is active or if the target is below 30% health to generate procs.
During Combustion, use Frostfire Bolt as your filler to generate Heating Up when no instant procs are available.
Use Fire Blast off-GCD to convert a Heating Up proc into a Hot Streak, but only if you do not already have a Hot Streak active.
Outside of Combustion, cast Meteor whenever available if the fight will last long enough for another Combustion.
Outside of Combustion, spend Hot Streak procs on Flamestrike for 4 or more targets.
Outside of Combustion, spend Pyroclasm procs on Flamestrike (4+ targets) only if the Combustion cooldown is longer than 12 seconds or you have 2 stacks.
Use Scorch whenever Heat Shimmer procs to generate Heating Up.
Use Scorch as your primary filler instead of Frostfire Bolt when the target is below 30% health if talented into Scald.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as your standard filler to generate Heating Up and Frostfire Empowerment stacks.
Always prioritize converting Heating Up into Hot Streak immediately if Combustion is active or if you are currently mid-cast.
